model_comparison.recommendation: Hazard beats the cure model on Brier in 4/4 split-horizons and B1 in 1/4 (cure beats B1 in 0/4); mean AUC hazard 0.579 vs B1 0.628; Brier gain over the cure model +0.0002 to +0.0032 (small). Recommendation: serve the hazard model in place of the cure model (with CQR-calibrated windows), but present its probabilities as close to the base rate: it does not reliably beat the first-source baseline B1.
